notes.title: SIGURAT Going Forward ( + my new game!)
notes.content:
Where are my SIGURAT updates?
I have been working on a new game for the past while, as well as going to University. That is why I haven’t been here working on SIGURAT content or promoting the game. I apologize for this. But alas! I am back!

What is this new game all about?
MEKA SIGURAT is my new FPS physics sandbox game about shooting/blasting/beating ROBOTS! Use hundreds of different items including weapons, ammos, consumables, grenades, placeables and more to FIGHT FOR YOUR SURVIVAL!

MEKA SIGURAT is my second-ever game! If no intergalactic calamity occurs, It should be released by the end of FEBRUARY and the price will be ~$15 USD.

I urge you to check it out! Add it to your wishlist if you are interested. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2182540/MEKA_SIGURAT/

But what about SIGURAT?
So what is the fate of SIGURAT? The spaceship shooty one? Well, before I started working on this new game I was knee-deep in developing some new SIGURAT content.

If the launch of my new game MEKA SIGURAT goes smoothly, and I am able to fix any important bugs that players have in a timely manner, then I plan to at least finish the SIGURAT update that I was working on. There is lots of polish I would love to do in SIGURAT once I have the time. Especially a UI revamp.

Also...
I’d like to thank the few of you who engage in the community discussions and leave reviews. It always makes me happy seeing people engage with my work. 

If you are still reading this, thanks for sticking around.

Cheers.
KD.

notes.title: Update 4 - Score Multiplier + Tweaks
notes.content:
Score Bonus Multiplier
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40885243/beacb3dcdba10faf957921fc9849dfc06e4ea4d0.png

 Slowly increase your score multiplier by destroying ships and gaining large amounts of points!
 Take too long a break from gaining points, and the multiplier will begin to rapidly decay!
 Rewards the most aggressive pilots!
 It is capped at 2x for now, lmk what u guys think


Less Exciting Changes

 Entities with less than 16 hit points will now use a more sensitive set of values for the sprite damage system, now they should suffer more vibrant visual damage than before

 Cutter and Welder are no longer starting ships, but instead cheap shipyard ships to encourage new players to play a bit longer than they might normally
 Increased prices of shipyard ships, they were super easy to unlock and now with the score multiplier it will be even easier to earn credits
 Buffed missles of the Lancer [CH] - will now steer away from asteroids, as well as path around asteroids to hit their target (epic gaming)

notes.title: Update 3 - some effects + more
notes.content:
hello!

NEW STUFF

 New Effect: Procedurally generated visual sprite damage based on damage taken

 New Ship: Viper - Has burst laser and cluster bombs (for purchase in shipyard)

notes.title: Update 2 -the new stuff update
notes.content:
I have been messing with other game proto stuff, but decided to take the weekend to cook this up. I hope you like it.

Shipyard

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40885243/d0b111954183fdc87c50ac809f6b506ceb698e78.png

Now you can buy ships with space skrilla earned at the end of each run
Some ships are still exclusively found in-game


Signal Scanner

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40885243/20e3b47b0d4a21638b8f94fa91d35dabf6c67cc0.png

See objects outside of the camera's view
Makes dealing with fast-enroaching enemies a little more forgiving
Shows nearby collectibles and allies
Helps to level playing field between different monitor sizes and resolutions


New Ships

New Ship: Swordfisher - has a railcannon and twin machineguns   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40885243/231f5a6b7594f7803f48a11bc2a615ad40f2df34.png
New Ship: Tailer - has a swarm pod and twin machineguns   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40885243/fad44abc5739587461ef2cedd4b0fcb99ff36d66.png


New Enemy

Can be found guarding the center of each sector...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40885243/2363560d2e0a8f129cf1c35c5cb0b48d47cd62c3.png

Fixes, Tweaks and Minor Things

If the magnitude of your ship's velocity vector is exactly 1.5x or greater than a colliding enemy ship that would deal contact damage, you will now destroy it without taking damage
Better explosion effects - more firework like true to classic arcade games
Created new collision matrices for turret targeting sensors - large battles with turreted ships should be slightly more performant
Added indicator of how many ships are unlocked/locked on the main menu
Buffed stats on some ships that felt lacking compared to the new ones
Made probes drop ship upgrade pickups
Reduced energy cost of all constructions
Made huge asteroid much rarer (got sick of looking at crusty ass sprite)
Reduced color intensity of certain UI elements that were distracting during gameplay


give a man a spaceship, learn him how to fly

notes.title: Update 1 - Two New Starting Ships + Fixes and Changes
notes.content:
Hi again! Sorry about the slow update schedule. I have been a bit busy with work, and I was also working on a thing for the game that I haven't yet got functioning the way I want. So in the meantime, here is everything else I was working on that DOES work! (I think)

NEW CONTENT

 Added two new ships accessible from the start to give new players more options!
     THE CUTTER: Twin laser guns with a missle barrage ability!
     THE WELDER: Fragment cannon with a gravity well ability!
 Changed powerups to slightly increase respective stat permanently until destruction of ship
 Added some more random probe encounters for extra points

FIXES and IMPROVEMENTS

 Changed the picker's ability to a instant reverse boost, its very fun
 Added forwards and backwards buttons to ship selection
 Slightly increased lancers firepower
 Slightly decreased projectile speed of other ships that may have made the lancer feel obsolete
 Fixed some tightly packed explosions giving invulnerability to entities in the blast radius
 Changed portal VFX to better resemble an actual portal
 Changed some projectile and ship sprite designs to look better
 T3 enemies no longer drop powerups, they are instead constructed from blueprints

Thanks again to those who leave comments and reviews, I enjoy reading all of them and they make me really excited to keep working on the game!

KD.

notes.title: Update 0.5 - Control Rebinding + Fixes + Ship
notes.content:
Hi again! I think I fixed some stuff that should have been working on launch, sorry about that.

NEW CONTENT

 A new ship to find and pilot, bringing the total of pilotable ships to 8 -> {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40885243/77d8df31bd6948b6c4edadfcae2845b833467229.png
 Controls rebinding - The new rebinding system allows you to change any action to a new button. The only  downside is that if you want to use a controller, you are forced to use the left joystick to  aim the direction of the ship. I haven't been able to test this with two controllers, so let me know if it works.

FIXES and IMPROVEMENTS

 I think I fixed the high scores not working properly. I tested it a lot and nothing went wrong, but if you find anything post about it on the forum!
 Rewrote a more modular structure for ships so future additions are much easier
 I am also resetting achievements, this shouldn't affect any actual progress, but it will take away the achievements accidentally given to early players because of my jank programming (the ones that reward for 2500, 12500, and 100000 kills milestones)
 Redid the OG lancer's particle effects, they are much better looking now

CURRENTLY KNOWN BUGS

 You cannot customize a bind to an axis-type controller input
 theres probably some more stuff 


Thank you to those who have left reviews and suggestions already! ːpraisesunː

KD.
